execution_model: Paper simulation only. Entries fill at the engulfing bar's close; exits at stop/target (V3/V5 partial leg at the +1.5R price); NO slippage, spread, or commissions modeled. The simulator never halts for balance or margin.

spec.data: GC.v.0 continuous, GLBX.MDP3 ohlcv-1m, traded as MGC ($10/pt)

pass_criteria: Checked in priority order V0 -> V3 -> V5; the first variant passing ALL of (a) 24-month net $ > 0 and net R > 0, (b) second half (2025-10-21..2026-10-20) net $ > 0 and net R > 0, (c) day-end equity trough above $0, is the bot's strategy. If none pass, no bot is built.

data_quality.note: Days with fewer than 300 RTH (09:30-16:00 ET) bars. Some are scheduled early closes (e.g. day after Thanksgiving, Christmas Eve, Jul 3 — a full early-close session is ~210 bars); Databento separately flagged 2025-09-17, 2025-09-24 and 2025-11-28 as degraded quality. Short days were NOT dropped: every day with session bars ran through the engine on whatever bars exist.

outcome: V0 baseline is the first variant passing all three criteria; it becomes the gold bot's strategy.
